arStrings.szText:
The four Lesser Evils have invaded Sanctuary. Travel through {icon:Marker_Duriel,2} {c_important}Helltides{/c}, the {icon:Marker_Andariel,2} {c_important}Kurast Undercity{/c}, {icon:Marker_Belial,2} {c_important}The Pit of the Artificer{/c} and the {icon:Marker_Azmodan,2} {c_important}Fields of Desecration{/c} to expel their presence.

Take this boon to begin your journey!
